# libarchive

- What: libarchive's 7-Zip, RAR and RAR 5 readers (multi-volume RAR included), built static into the launcher, whose importer opens .7z and .rar archives with them (assets/archive_source.cpp). Reading only; no writers, no disk or file helpers, no other format.
- Version: 3.8.11 (30 October 2026).
- Origin: https://github.com/libarchive/libarchive/releases/download/v3.8.11/libarchive-3.8.11.tar.gz
- Archive SHA-256: 900fe9fc7237c2b04f090f3c3648de8fe597525771f5035016537ce2d667d12b (computed here from the download).
- Signature: libarchive-3.8.11.tar.gz.asc from the same release verified with Martin Matuska's key (fingerprint 659C 84C0 E23E A1FA 97E0 B58C C040 B508 D63D 2B36, the key on his GitHub account, https://api.github.com/users/mmatuska/gpg_keys): good signature.
- Taken: 2026-11-09.
- License: BSD 2-clause (COPYING, as published). archive_blake2.h, archive_blake2_impl.h, archive_blake2s_ref.c and archive_blake2sp_ref.c are offered under CC0 1.0, OpenSSL or Apache 2.0 (COPYING says so; their headers say the same); this program takes them under CC0 1.0. No file kept here is under the UC Regents licence COPYING also names.
- Kept: COPYING, and from libarchive/ these C sources and headers, unchanged except archive_string.c (below): archive.h archive_acl.c archive_acl_private.h archive_blake2.h archive_blake2_impl.h archive_blake2s_ref.c archive_blake2sp_ref.c archive_check_magic.c archive_crc32.c archive_endian.h archive_entry.c archive_entry.h archive_entry_locale.h archive_entry_private.h archive_entry_sparse.c archive_entry_xattr.c archive_integer.h archive_options.c archive_options_private.h archive_platform.h archive_platform_stat.h archive_ppmd7.c archive_ppmd7_private.h archive_ppmd_private.h archive_private.h archive_random.c archive_random_private.h archive_rb.c archive_rb.h archive_read.c archive_read_add_passphrase.c archive_read_private.h archive_read_set_options.c archive_read_support_format_7zip.c archive_read_support_format_rar.c archive_read_support_format_rar5.c archive_string.c archive_string.h archive_string_composition.h archive_string_sprintf.c archive_time.c archive_time_private.h archive_util.c archive_virtual.c archive_windows.c (Windows only) archive_windows.h.
- Dropped: everything else in the archive (configure, CMake and autotools files, build/, the other readers, the writers, the filters, the disk and file helpers, bsdtar, bsdcpio, bsdcat, bsdunzip, contrib, doc, examples, test_utils and the tests).
- Local change: CMakeLists.txt and config.h are ours, not libarchive's: a static library target `tpw_archive` (alias `LibArchive::LibArchive`) whose config.h is written by hand in place of the configure step, no install rules, no probing of the host. One source change: archive_string.c's default_iconv_charset() returns "UTF-8" where it would return "" on a system with neither iconv nor nl_langinfo (this build uses neither), so names in a 7-Zip (UTF-16) or RAR archive come out as UTF-8 rather than with '?' for every character outside ASCII. The line is marked "tpw:".
- Compression: 7-Zip's LZMA and LZMA2 (through liblzma, third_party/xz), PPMd, BCJ, BCJ2, ARM, ARM64, PowerPC, IA-64, SPARC, RISC-V and Delta (libarchive's own or liblzma's), Deflate (zlib, third_party/zlib) and stored; RAR 2.9 to 4 (LZSS, PPMd, the filters) and RAR 5, both libarchive's own. Not built: BZip2 (no bzip2 library: 7-Zip writes it only when asked to and RAR never does), Zstandard, LZ4, Brotli, encryption (no crypto library: an archive with a password gets a message saying so). The importer refuses those with a message naming the archive.
- Export: tpw-decomp and tpw-port (the launcher's importer links it; tpw-port builds tpw-decomp's tree, as with zlib).
